trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks, so there is no separate task here. Work the roadmap in order, leave the 100% cleanup for last, and this lands on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission of Chapter 1. Play the story and it unlocks after the first job, with nothing to prepare in advance.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Keep cheats off for the whole run: PowerPyx reports that cheats disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Story trophies are automatic and cannot be missed, so just keep playing.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The chapter trophies unlock in order as the story advances.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. By this point most side activities are open, but the chapter itself only needs its story missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. It is the last story trophy; after the credits the open world stays open, so all cleanup happens afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story heist The Cartel Heist. Heist missions unlock in story order; finish the setup steps and the heist itself.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears. A story trophy, so it unlocks by playing through.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Automatic story trophy, unlocked by finishing the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Finish the mission objectives and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy, unlocked by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work the checklist. It is roughly 60% of true completion, so you do not need everything: most of it comes from doing the other trophies. Nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses and air time that the tracker counts (Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities). Chain them while driving between missions; 250 sounds like a lot, but they rack up across a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types. Sample one of each: races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade and the rest. Check Activities to see which type you have not tried yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold needs speed and accuracy, so learn each range's layout first, then go for the medal runs one weapon at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at each Top Fun location. Learn the gates on a practice run first, then race clean: cutting the racing line saves more time than top speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Street, off-road, boat and air races all count as different events, so vary the event instead of repeating the same race twenty times.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing duel and out-fish him. Match the lure to the water and keep the line tension steady: losing the fish costs the round.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game in full. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through to its end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand: finish Andy's last mission. Stranger strands unlock across the map as the story advances, so clear Andy's chain when it appears.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand: finish Kenton's last mission. Work through his chain of missions as they unlock across Leonida.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand: finish Billy's last mission. Clear his missions in order as they appear on the map.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger strands. There are more than eight in the state, so pick the shortest chains first and mop up the rest after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand: finish Randy's last mission. Follow his chain to its end when the missions unlock.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger mission strand: finish Tyrone's last mission. Clear his missions in order as they appear.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable, so handle it first. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, for Jason and Lucia, and the first spot, offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1, becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter. Meditate there the moment it is offered, then work the other spots as you explore, and check the count before leaving Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Track it with the binoculars first, then take the shot cleanly: a spooked animal wastes the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any three card sets. Cards hide across Leonida, and a set completes when every card in it is found, so sweep one region at a time instead of hopping between sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots. It is a count trophy, so work it into your exploration and check the counter so you do not repeat a spot.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. They overlap heavily with the 100% checklist, which wants 70, so this pops naturally on the road to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the countryside and water to lose the search cone faster.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping the same wanted level. Plan the route first, three shops close together, and do not let the level drop between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find and log 100 vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so scan everything you drive or pass, and this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Group five enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. Herd them into one spot first: a narrow street or doorway does the grouping for you.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule: steal a plane and take off. Expect a wanted level, so climb fast and lose it in the clouds.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get inside a Rhino tank. Tanks answer to high wanted levels, so build heat near a military area and grab one when it rolls in, or find one parked at a base.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Clear a jewelry store without tripping a single alarm or camera. Go in quiet, move slowly, and leave before the staff or the law notices.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan the getaway vehicle before you go in: the escape is the hard half.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and escape. Stop it on a quiet road, crack it fast, and be moving before the response arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida. Drive the map edge to edge; the trophy pops when the last region registers, so check the map for the corner you have never driven.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation per gang. Each gang runs its own rackets: find one of each and rob it.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and enjoy the view. A quiet moment trophy: sit, order, and let the scene play.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a showroom window. Pick the car, line up the glass, and floor it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through. Play a full frame: the trophy is about the follow-through, not the score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build your partnership's appeal to its peak. Keep doing partner activities together and the trophy pops when the partnership hits its best.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A story-choice trophy: it unlocks when a major choice plays out. It is tied to the story, so keep playing, the choice comes to you.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail, then succeed: the second attempt is the charm. If a story moment gives you a second try, take it, the trophy rewards the retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A story moment trophy for a scene that defies explanation. Keep playing the story; it unlocks when the scene does.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock pins over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle at the bowling pins. Line the car up and swing as you pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Bank the bills after heists and robberies and route them through contacts regularly: it adds up across the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops of any kind. Big purchases count, vehicles, property upgrades, clothes, so this pops naturally by late game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Save the purchase spree for after the story, when cash is plentiful.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app, and register each one.
